title: Let the Guru's word rein the mind
summary: This meets the unruly moment when cleverness wants dignity without being governed. The line says the mind is honored only when the Guru's word takes the reins.
takeaway: Let the Guru's word take the reins.
lifeApplication: Before you enter the meeting or answer the message, ask what is holding your mind right now. Choose one line of Shabad before image or cleverness takes the lead.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru's word reins the mind into right order.
source.lifeApplication: At the threshold, let one line hold the mind before image does.

evidence.coreClaim: The Guru's word reins the mind into right order.
